{{EventEnd|The Classic Event|date = 28th of May 2024}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = TDSClassicMiniEventPromo.png |dates = 23 May 2024 – 28 May 2024 |acts = 5 |act_name = Missions |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The Classic|The Classic]] |previous_event = [[April Fools 2024 Event|Skibidi]] |next_event = [[Hexscape Event|Hexscape]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''The Classic Event''' was the sixteenth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. This was a Roblox sponsored event that took part in [[w:c:roblox:The Classic|The Classic]] event. Because of this, it was possible to unlock {{Token|5}} and {{Tix|10}}. {{Token|}} were unlocked by triumphing maps, while {{Tix|}} could have been found on the map. {{Tix|5}} could be found in the lobby, while the other {{Tix|5}} were found in the maps, one for each. The event released on 23rd of May 2024 on 18:00 UTC and ended on the 28th of May 2024. Beating this event rewarded you with the {{Color|Classic|Guest}} [[Scout]] skin. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:ClassicCandyCaneLaneIcon.png|150px|link=Classic Candy Cane Lane]] |[[File:ClassicWinterIcon.png|150px|link=Classic Winter]] |[[File:ClassicForestCampIcon.png|150px|link=Classic Forest Camp]] |[[File:ClassicIslandChaosIcon.png|150px|link=Classic Island Chaos]] |- |[[Classic Candy Cane Lane]] |[[Classic Winter]] |[[Classic Forest Camp]] |[[Classic Island Chaos]] |- |[[File:ClassicCastleIcon.png|150px|link=Classic Castle]] |- |[[Classic Castle]] |} ==Skins== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:GuestScout.png|200px|link=Scout/Gallery]] |- |[[Scout/Gallery|{{Color|Classic|Guest}} Scout]] |} ==Nametags== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Classic nametag.gif|200px|link=Classic Nametag]] |- |[[Classic Nametag]] |} ==Enemies==

Tower Defense Simulator x Roblox|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheClassicUpdateThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TCIcon1.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TDSClassicMiniEventPromo.png }} ==Trivia== *'''The Classic Event''' had the most amount of maps out of any event. *'''The Classic Event''' had the most amount of badges added in a single event, totalling at 15. *'''The Classic Event''' is the first event in the game to be completely solo-only, not allowing grouped matches at all. **Although [[The Hunt Event]] technically was solo-only, the Hard difficulty there still allowed multiplayer matches, meaning this event would be the second to have a solo-only mode. *This was the shortest event in Tower Defense Simulator's history, lasting only 5 days. {{EventNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:The Classic Event}}
